out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is observed to be unsound or adulterated: Chocolate milk with expiration date 4/7/26, were returned by patrons due to spoilage smell.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food shall be safe, unadulterated and honestly presented as specified under 3-601.12. All chocolate Mille with expiration date of 4/7/26 were ordered to be discarded. All were discarded during the inspection. Check food foods for possible spoilage. Do not serve foods on their expiration dates.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:black beans =44F, cut lettuce=46F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.Both replaced during the inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lighting Intensity, 50 Foot Candles Minimum
violations.observation: Observed that inadequate lighting was provided in the food preparation areas. Three of seven light bulbs under the exhaust hood system were noted to have burned out, providing less illumination.
violations.corrective_action: Increase the lighting to provide a minimum of 50 foot candles in all food preparation areas. Replace. These burned out bulbs.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not designed or constructed to be easily cleanable: Wood-block and cardboard padding observed used as legs to support shelving inside the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. REPLACE THE WOODEN BLOCK AND CARDBOARD SUPPORTS WITH APPROVED WHEELS THAT CAN BE RETROFITTED TO THE SHELVING.
